purpose: Improve useful price estimates with different algorithms and objectives; audit purpose mismatches without hiding difficult offers
prior_knowledge: S02/S02b/S02c train, CV and S02 validation results are known. Reused CV is development evidence, not a fresh unbiased test. Five title-flagged train descriptions reviewed without prices before fitting.
features: Original 18 available in S03 form; derived candidates add guests_per_bedroom (studio=1), beds_per_guest, bathrooms_per_guest, distance to 52.52/13.405 and missing-basic-count. No new source data or host/price/text/review inputs.
scope_audit: Conservative title-only event/photo/film-use patterns in scope_audit.py. Flags are review signals, not proven non-lodging. Keep all rows in main evaluation and catalogue; one explicit training-only exclusion sensitivity candidate.

selection.ranking: Eligible variant with lowest pooled MAE, then name. At most one promoted to validation. If none qualifies, retain S02 and do not evaluate validation.
selection.failure: Keep S02; never fall through to next candidate or change gates after seeing outcomes

diagnostics.rows: Every original held-out real row, unchanged price, no trimming or winsorisation
diagnostics.learning_curve_candidate: Lowest pooled MAE among non-control variants regardless of promotion; diagnostics only

deployment: Promote only after CV gate and validation gate. Preserve S02 immutable artifacts and independent OOF catalogue path. If unsuccessful, keep S03 app on S02 and report limitations. No cloud deployment in this experiment.
